//: Updates stay within their major versions, and the major update is listed rather than made.
title: The package manager updates within majors, and the major update is held back and named

replies.npm:
Package   Current  Wanted  Latest  Location
express   4.18.2   4.21.2  5.1.0   node_modules/express
left-pad  1.1.0    1.3.0   1.3.0   node_modules/left-pad

proof:
npm update
cat <<'EVAL_EOF'
Updated within their majors: left-pad 1.1.0 to 1.3.0, express 4.18.2 to 4.21.2. Held back: express 5.1.0, a major update with breaking changes.
EVAL_EOF
